popCulture.title: Salmoneus
popCulture.description: The Aeolid king who drove a bronze chariot for thunder — Zeus' lightning still answers false divinity.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil places Salmoneus among the damned who mocked the gods — the chariot of false thunder rolling in Tartarus.
